prompt:

Visual identity from the reference brand board: near-black Ink #0B0D10 background, bone-white #F6F4EE text, hairline rules, JetBrains Mono for data, Inter for UI. Pixel art world in restrained duotone greens on black, never candy colors. Verify green #1FD598 ONLY on verified items (seal seam, passed checks); denials use a red alert bar #E5484D. Real content only: agents are Muse Spark and Muse Code, payment 'Pay 200.00 USD to acme-991 (ref A-991)', attack 'poisoned MCP tool', latency in microseconds. No fake logos, no customer names, no prices.
Composition: two pixel-art worlds split by a glowing vertical seam. Left 45%: the agents' office: labeled pixel characters 'Muse Spark', a swarm of small 'Muse Code' workers, a hooded 'open-weights attacker'. Center: a tall vertical seam that is the Mandate seal's split, acting as the teller window; a payment envelope crossing it glows green, while the attacker's envelope bounces off as the seal halves refuse to meet, red alert bar. Right 45%: the bank branch with vault and golden ledger and a trophy wall of blocked attacks. Speech bubbles in plain sentences with latency. Thin top bar with the Mandate wordmark and counters.
